name: Kopage
summary: White-label AI website builder for freelancers and agencies that build sites for local clients: start from AI or a template, hosting in European or US datacenters, own domains, plans priced by the number of active websites, plus a free self-hosted PHP version.
best_for: freelancers and small agencies that build simple websites for local clients and want to sell them under their own brand, with hosting included
skip_if: you need one website for yourself, where the Single Website plan or the free self-hosted version costs less; you need deep design or code control; or you want a refund window before you commit
honest_knock: The terms say Kopage generally does not give refunds, and the trial is 7 days. The AI token allowance (10K on Solo, 100K above) comes with no published reset period or top-up price, and self-hosting a client site on Scale or Unlimited costs an extra fee that is not published. Paddle, the merchant of record, handles returns, while the refund clause is written for downloaded licences, so how a refund request on a cloud plan is treated is not spelled out. The self-hosted pricing page still carries an older FAQ (an Agency Plan with 10 sites, $5 a month per extra site and a 14-day trial per site) that does not match the current cloud plans. The Single Website plan covers one static website and is provided by Website•IM.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-16 in a browser on kopage.com/pricing and kopage.com/pricing-self-hosted, from a Netherlands connection, prices shown in euros; local sales tax, GST or VAT may apply) Kopage sells two things. Kopage Studio, the cloud white-label builder for agencies, has four monthly plans priced by the number of active websites: Solo 49 € a month for 5 websites with 10K AI tokens; Pro 149 € for 25 websites with 100K AI tokens and custom branding of the admin area; Scale 349 € for 100 websites, 100K AI tokens and a separate cloud instance; Unlimited 699 € for unlimited websites with the same 100K AI tokens and separate instance. Every plan is white-label and lets you connect your own domains. No yearly prices were shown for these plans. On Scale and Unlimited a client site can also be self-hosted on the client's own server, for additional fees the page does not state, and fair-use limits on disk space and bandwidth may apply. For a single site, a Single Website plan (a service provided by Website•IM) is 9 € a month billed annually or 19 € monthly for 1 static website. The self-hosted PHP version is free with unlimited websites; Basic Website is $50 a year and Business Website $150 a year, each for 1 website with premium support. The pricing page offers a 7-day free trial; the terms say Kopage generally does not give refunds. Re-read on 25 October 2026 with a plain fetch of kopage.com/pricing and kopage.com/pricing-self-hosted: all plans and limits unchanged, and again unchanged on kopage.com/pricing on 13 November 2026. The plan cards print the same figure in four currencies, $49, 49 €, 49 CHF and 49 GBP for Solo and likewise for every plan, so the number stays the same whichever currency you are shown. Orders are processed by Paddle.com as merchant of record (terms, section 9). Kopage also sells a School Plan and a Community Plan on separate pages (read 13 November 2026), each from $99 a month with 10 websites included and extra basic websites at $1 a month; the Community page adds business websites at $5 a month.

schema_offer.description: Solo, billed monthly, 5 active websites, 10K AI tokens, white-label, own domains; Pro 149 € for 25 websites and 100K tokens; Scale 349 € for 100 websites; Unlimited 699 €; Single Website 9 € a month billed annually or 19 € monthly; self-hosted free, Basic $50 and Business $150 a year; local tax may apply. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-13.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested Kopage Studio in the 7-day trial that we started through Paddle. The AI generator made an English plumbing site in about 20 seconds, but the editor menus stay in the browser language. The Paddle receipt shows EUR 59.29 after the trial, which is the 49 EUR Solo price plus 21 percent VAT. Cancelling took one click on Paddle, but the link sits in the receipt, not in the Kopage account. Account and start: we created the account and started the 7-day Kopage Studio trial through Paddle with his own card. Our AI assistant ran the test in our browser, in its own tab, on 19 November 2026 from 15:01 to 15:06. The account pages were in English; the website editor follows the browser language and showed its menus in Dutch even with an English language parameter, and it has no language setting, so no editor menus are in the evidence. Core action, a website from the AI generator: Create a new website, Generate with AI, one sentence. The first attempt, a plumbing company in Rotterdam, gave a Dutch site with some English headings left in. The second, an English-language site for a plumbing company in Boston, was ready in about 20 seconds in 3 steps: Reliant Plumbing, Reliable Plumbing Solutions, Get a Free Estimate, sections on services, 500+ Happy Clients, a testimonial and a FAQ. Both sites stay as Draft; nothing was published. The headline was edited inline to Plumbing You Can Trust and saved with the tick. The block library and modules (forms, map, shop, blog, newsletter, translations, members area) were only looked at. The logo setting is a file plus a style editor, not a logo maker. No AI token counter was visible. White label: Kopage Studio is a white-label website builder for agencies and professional. Each new website you create is white-label by default. Client domains connect through CNAME records, hosting is in Europe or Texas, and clients log in by adding /admin to the site address. No separate client screen or invite flow was found. Plans and trial: Billing & invoices has one line, 2026/11/19 - Kopage Studio, linking to the Paddle receipt: Payment method: Free, trial 19 Nov 2026 - 25 Nov 2026, EUR 0.00, VAT (0%) EUR 0.00, and We won't charge you in the free trial. Once it ends, your subscription will renew at EUR 59.29 unless you cancel, by 25 Nov 2026. The receipt does not name the tier; EUR 59.29 equals 49 EUR plus 21 percent Dutch VAT, so it fits the Solo plan of 49 EUR. Checkout: the Paddle trial checkout was done by us before the session and was not seen; only the receipt was read. Cancelling, done the same day: there is no cancel button in the Kopage account. The route is Billing, the invoice line, the Paddle receipt, the link review your subscription, and Paddle's page Manage your subscription for Kopage Studio, with Update card details and Cancel subscription. One click on Cancel subscription showed Your subscription has been canceled. No reason form, no retention offer and no password. Done on 19 November 2026 at about 14:20 UTC. Whether the trial stays usable until 25 November was not checked. Not tested: publishing, a domain, inviting a client, custom admin branding, the shop, blog, members area and newsletter, and the template route. Clean up: the account and two draft sites stay; nothing was published. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The editor menus follow the browser language and cannot be switched to English. A prompt about a Dutch city gave a Dutch site. There is no cancel button in the Kopage account; the cancel link is in the Paddle receipt.
